title: BEACON SitRep — validate-or-fallback / anti-hallucination gate
description: Validates a GENERATED SitRep object (SPEC §6.3 grounding/JSON-schema validation & citation enforcement; §2.4 citations[]; DOMAIN_MODEL §2 SITREP + CITATION; Constitution Art. XI/XII). The LLM emits a SitRep against THIS schema; on parse/contract/citation failure the system rejects it and falls back to deterministic-only (no narrative) — UW3/F4. Numbers in summary/priorities are narrated from the deterministic engine, never invented by the LLM (Art. XII). citations[] is REQUIRED and MUST be non-empty: a SitRep that has narrative (summary/priorities) but empty citations[] MUST FAIL validation — that is the F2 100%-citation-coverage gate. Citation shape mirrors source-ref.schema.json#/$defs/citation (field, sourceId, claim → SOURCE_RECORD).

incidentId.description: FK -> incident.id this SitRep summarizes (DOMAIN_MODEL §2 SITREP.incident_id).

generatedAt.description: When this SitRep was generated. ISO 8601 with timezone (DOMAIN_MODEL SITREP.generated_at).

summary.description: Generated narrative executive summary. A grounded narration of deterministic facts; every claim in it must be backed by >=1 entry in citations[] (Art. XII; F2). On deterministic-only fallback this may be templated/omitted at the application layer, but when present it must remain cited.

priorities.description: Ranked attention areas — DETERMINISTIC and reproducibly ordered (SPEC §5.2 weighted priority ranking; DOMAIN_MODEL SITREP.priorities). The LLM narrates priorities[].rationale but never reorders or invents the ranking (Art. XII/F3).

rank.description: 1-based deterministic rank (stable ordering from the engine's priority_score, SPEC §5.2). Lower = higher priority.

label.description: Short identifier of the attention area (e.g. exposed cluster/node name). Deterministic engine output, not LLM-invented.

rationale.description: Generated narration of WHY this is ranked here. Cited: the corresponding 'priorities[<n>].rationale' field must appear in citations[] (F2).

score.description: Optional deterministic priority_score in [0,1] (SPEC §5.2). Computed by the engine, echoed here; never produced by the LLM.

trend.description: Escalation trend of the incident (DOMAIN_MODEL SITREP.trend).

aiMode.description: Which LLMPort ladder rung produced this SitRep (SPEC §6.1; DOMAIN_MODEL SITREP.ai_mode). Echoes the rung used: 'cloud' (Groq/OpenRouter/Claude), 'local' (Ollama), or 'deterministic-only' (no narrative — UW3/F4 fallback).

citations.description: REQUIRED and NON-EMPTY (minItems:1). Every generated narrative field (summary, each priorities[].rationale, trend) must be grounded by >=1 citation referencing a SOURCE_RECORD (Art. XI/XII; SPEC §2.4/§6.3). The F2 gate: a SitRep carrying summary/priorities with an EMPTY citations[] MUST FAIL this schema. Citation shape mirrors source-ref.schema.json#/$defs/citation.

field.description: Which SitRep field this citation grounds (e.g. 'summary', 'priorities[0].rationale', 'trend'). Mirrors source-ref.schema.json#/$defs/citation.field.

sourceId.description: FK -> sourceRecord.id that substantiates the claim (DOMAIN_MODEL CITATION.source_id).

claim.description: The specific cited fact/claim drawn from the source.
